name: Quintanilla de Trigueros (Spain)
description: Horizontally divided white over green, the white charged with four red crosses and the green with five yellow discs.
history: Municipal flag of Quintanilla de Trigueros; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: four crosses in a row on the white
five discs in a row on the green
